title: त्रिचत्वारिंशत्तमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Janamejaya asks to hear of Kumara's consecration, and Vaishampayana tells how Agni, Ganga and the Krittikas, with Shiva and Uma, brought forth the child on a golden reed-bed. The gods came to see him, and the assembly gathered on the bank of the Sarasvati.
summary.kn: ಕುಮಾರನ ಅಭಿಷೇಕದ ಕಥೆ ಕೇಳಲು ಜನಮೇಜಯ ಕೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಅಗ್ನಿ, ಗಂಗೆ, ಕೃತ್ತಿಕೆಯರು, ಶಿವ-ಉಮೆಯರ ಮೂಲಕ ಶಿಶು ಚಿನ್ನದ ಜೊಂಡಿನ ಹಾಸಿಗೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಜನಿಸಿದುದನ್ನು ವೈಶಂಪಾಯನ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ದೇವತೆಗಳು ನೋಡಲು ಬಂದು ಸರಸ್ವತಿ ತೀರದಲ್ಲಿ ಸೇರಿದರು.
summary.hi: जनमेजय कुमार के अभिषेक की कथा सुनना चाहते हैं, और वैशम्पायन बताते हैं कि अग्नि, गंगा, कृत्तिकाओं तथा शिव-उमा से बालक सोने के सरकण्डों की शय्या पर उत्पन्न हुआ। देवता उसे देखने आए और सरस्वती तट पर सभा जुटी।
summary.te: కుమారుని అభిషేక కథ చెప్పమని జనమేజయుడు అడుగుతాడు; అగ్ని, గంగ, కృత్తికలు, శివ ఉమల ద్వారా బాలుడు బంగారు రెల్లు శయ్యపై జన్మించిన కథను వైశంపాయనుడు చెబుతాడు. దేవతలు చూడటానికి వచ్చి సరస్వతీ తీరంలో సమావేశమయ్యారు.
summary.ta: குமாரனின் முடிசூட்டுக் கதையைக் கேட்க ஜனமேஜயன் வேண்ட, அக்னி, கங்கை, கார்த்திகைப் பெண்கள், சிவன் உமை மூலம் குழந்தை பொன் நாணற் படுக்கையில் பிறந்த கதையை வைசம்பாயனர் கூறுகிறார். தேவர் காண வந்து சரஸ்வதிக் கரையில் கூடினர்.
summary.ml: കുമാരന്റെ അഭിഷേകത്തിന്റെ കഥ കേൾക്കണമെന്ന് ജനമേജയൻ ആവശ്യപ്പെടുന്നു; അഗ്നി, ഗംഗ, കൃത്തികമാർ എന്നിവരോടൊപ്പം ശിവനും ഉമയും ചേർന്ന് സ്വർണ്ണത്തണ്ടുകളുടെ കിടക്കയിൽ കുട്ടിയെ പ്രസവിക്കുന്നത് വൈശമ്പായനൻ വിവരിക്കുന്നു. ദേവന്മാർ അവനെ കാണാൻ വന്നു; സരസ്വതിയുടെ തീരത്ത് സദസ്സു ചേരുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 9.43; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Jun 23 2020

sections.title: सारस्वतपर्व
sections.titleEn: Sarasvata Parva (Balarama's pilgrimage on the Sarasvati)

verses.text: जनमेजय उवाच

meaning.en: Janamejaya said:

verses.text:
सरस्वत्याः प्रभावोऽयमुक्तस्ते द्विजसत्तम ।
कुमारस्याभिषेकं तु ब्रह्मन्व्याख्यातुमर्हसि ॥

meaning.en: You have told me this power of the Sarasvati, best of Brahmins; now, Brahmin, you should explain the consecration of Kumara.

verses.text:
यस्मिन्काले च देशे च यथा च वदतां वर ।
यैश्चाभिषिक्तो भगवान्विधिना येन च प्रभुः ॥

meaning.en: Tell me all of it, best of speakers: at what time and place, by whom the blessed lord was consecrated and by what rite,

verses.text:
स्कन्दो यथा च दैत्यानामकरोत्कदनं महत् ।
तथा मे सर्वमाचक्ष्व परं कौतूहलं हि मे ॥

meaning.en: and how Skanda made great slaughter among the Daityas; my curiosity is very great.

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
कुरुवंशस्य सदृशमिदं कौतूहलं तव ।
हर्षमुत्पादयत्येतद्वचो मे जनमेजय ॥

meaning.en: This curiosity of yours, Janamejaya, is worthy of the Kuru line, and your words bring me joy.

verses.text:
हन्त ते कथयिष्यामि शृण्वानस्य जनाधिप ।
अभिषेकं कुमारस्य प्रभावं च महात्मनः ॥

meaning.en: Lord of men, I will gladly tell you, as you listen, the consecration of Kumara and the power of that great soul.

verses.text:
तेजो माहेश्वरं स्कन्नमग्नौ प्रपतितं पुरा ।
तत्सर्वभक्षो भगवान्नाशकद्दग्धुमक्षयम् ॥

meaning.en: Long ago the seed of Maheshvara, fallen, dropped into the fire; the blessed all-devouring Agni could not burn that imperishable thing.

verses.text:
तेनासीदति तेजस्वी दीप्तिमान्हव्यवाहनः ।
न चैव धारयामास गर्भं तेजोमयं तदा ॥

meaning.en: Because of it the brilliant, blazing carrier of oblations was afflicted, and he could not then bear that embryo made of fire.

verses.text:
स गङ्गामभिसंगम्य नियोगाद्ब्रह्मणः प्रभुः ।
गर्भमाहितवान्दिव्यं भास्करोपमतेजसम् ॥

meaning.en: He went to the Ganga and, at the command of Brahma, the lord placed the divine embryo of sun-like brilliance in her.

verses.text:
अथ गङ्गापि तं गर्भमसहन्ती विधारणे ।
उत्ससर्ज गिरौ रम्ये हिमवत्यमरार्चिते ॥

meaning.en: Then the Ganga too, unable to hold that embryo, cast it down on the lovely Himalaya, worshiped by the gods.

verses.text:
स तत्र ववृधे लोकानावृत्य ज्वलनात्मजः ।
ददृशुर्ज्वलनाकारं तं गर्भमथ कृत्तिकाः ॥

meaning.en: There the son of Agni grew, filling the worlds, and the Krittikas saw that embryo in the form of flame.

verses.text:
शरस्तम्बे महात्मानमनलात्मजमीश्वरम् ।
ममायमिति ताः सर्वाः पुत्रार्थिन्योऽभिचक्रमुः ॥

meaning.en: Seeing that great-souled lord, son of fire, in a clump of reeds, all of them, wishing for a son, rushed to him, each saying "He is mine."

verses.text:
तासां विदित्वा भावं तं मातॄणां भगवान्प्रभुः ।
प्रस्नुतानां पयः षड्भिर्वदनैरपिबत्तदा ॥

meaning.en: Knowing the feeling of those mothers, the blessed lord then drank their milk, which flowed, with his six mouths.

verses.text:
तं प्रभावं समालक्ष्य तस्य बालस्य कृत्तिकाः ।
परं विस्मयमापन्ना देव्यो दिव्यवपुर्धराः ॥

meaning.en: Seeing that power of the child, the Krittikas, goddesses of divine bodies, were filled with supreme wonder.

verses.text:
यत्रोत्सृष्टः स भगवान्गङ्गया गिरिमूर्धनि ।
स शैलः काञ्चनः सर्वः संबभौ कुरुसत्तम ॥

meaning.en: The peak of the mountain where the blessed one was cast down by the Ganga shone, best of Kurus, wholly golden.

verses.text:
वर्धता चैव गर्भेण पृथिवी तेन रञ्जिता ।
अतश्च सर्वे संवृत्ता गिरयः काञ्चनाकराः ॥

meaning.en: By the growing embryo the earth was colored, and from then on all mountains became mines of gold.

verses.text:
कुमारश्च महावीर्यः कार्त्तिकेय इति स्मृतः ।
गाङ्गेयः पूर्वमभवन्महायोगबलान्वितः ॥

meaning.en: The mighty boy is remembered as Karttikeya; formerly he was Gangeya, the son of Ganga, endowed with the strength of great yoga.

verses.text:
स देवस्तपसा चैव वीर्येण च समन्वितः ।
ववृधेऽतीव राजेन्द्र चन्द्रवत्प्रियदर्शनः ॥

meaning.en: That god, endowed with austerity and power, grew greatly, king of kings, handsome as the moon.

verses.text:
स तस्मिन्काञ्चने दिव्ये शरस्तम्बे श्रिया वृतः ।
स्तूयमानस्तदा शेते गन्धर्वैर्मुनिभिस्तथा ॥

meaning.en: Surrounded by splendor, he lay in that divine golden reed-clump, praised by gandharvas and sages.

verses.text:
तथैनमन्वनृत्यन्त देवकन्याः सहस्रशः ।
दिव्यवादित्रनृत्तज्ञाः स्तुवन्त्यश्चारुदर्शनाः ॥

meaning.en: Thousands of divine maidens danced after him, skilled in divine music and dance, praising him, lovely to look at.

verses.text:
अन्वास्ते च नदी देवं गङ्गा वै सरितां वरा ।
दधार पृथिवी चैनं बिभ्रती रूपमुत्तमम् ॥

meaning.en: The river Ganga, best of rivers, attended the god, and the Earth bore him, holding that supreme form.

verses.text:
जातकर्मादिकास्तस्य क्रियाश्चक्रे बृहस्पतिः ।
वेदश्चैनं चतुर्मूर्तिरुपतस्थे कृताञ्जलिः ॥

meaning.en: Brihaspati performed for him the birth rites and the rest, and the Veda, in four forms, stood before him with joined palms.

verses.text:
धनुर्वेदश्चतुष्पादः शस्त्रग्रामः ससंग्रहः ।
तत्रैनं समुपातिष्ठत्साक्षाद्वाणी च केवला ॥

meaning.en: The four-part science of the bow, with the whole host of weapons and their collections, attended him there, and Speech herself in her pure form.

verses.text:
स ददर्श महावीर्यं देवदेवमुमापतिम् ।
शैलपुत्र्या सहासीनं भूतसंघशतैर्वृतम् ॥

meaning.en: He saw the greatly mighty god of gods, the lord of Uma, seated with the daughter of the mountain, surrounded by hundreds of troops of spirits.

verses.text:
निकाया भूतसंघानां परमाद्भुतदर्शनाः ।
विकृता विकृताकारा विकृताभरणध्वजाः ॥

meaning.en: Those troops of spirits were of most wondrous aspect, misshapen, with misshapen forms, ornaments and banners.

verses.text:
व्याघ्रसिंहर्क्षवदना बिडालमकराननाः ।
वृषदंशमुखाश्चान्ये गजोष्ट्रवदनास्तथा ॥

meaning.en: Some had faces of tigers, lions and bears, others faces of cats and makaras, others of the bhasa bird, elephants and camels.

verses.text:
उलूकवदनाः केचिद्गृध्रगोमायुदर्शनाः ।
क्रौञ्चपारावतनिभैर्वदनै राङ्कवैरपि ॥

meaning.en: Some had faces of owls, some looked like vultures and jackals, with faces like cranes and pigeons and the ranku deer.

verses.text:
श्वाविच्छल्यकगोधानां खरैडकगवां तथा ।
सदृशानि वपूंष्यन्ये तत्र तत्र व्यधारयन् ॥

meaning.en: Others bore bodies like dogs, porcupines, iguanas, donkeys, goats and cows, here and there.

verses.text:
केचिच्छैलाम्बुदप्रख्याश्चक्रालातगदायुधाः ।
केचिदञ्जनपुञ्जाभाः केचिच्छ्वेताचलप्रभाः ॥

meaning.en: Some looked like mountains and clouds, with discs, firebrands and clubs as weapons; some were like heaps of collyrium, some bright as a white mountain.

verses.text:
सप्तमातृगणाश्चैव समाजग्मुर्विशां पते ।
साध्या विश्वेऽथ मरुतो वसवः पितरस्तथा ॥

meaning.en: The groups of the Seven Mothers also came, lord of men, with the Sadhyas, Vishvedevas, Maruts, Vasus and ancestors,

verses.text:
रुद्रादित्यास्तथा सिद्धा भुजगा दानवाः खगाः ।
ब्रह्मा स्वयंभूर्भगवान्सपुत्रः सह विष्णुना ॥

meaning.en: the Rudras, Adityas, Siddhas, serpents, Danavas and birds; the blessed self-born Brahma with his son and Vishnu.

verses.text:
शक्रस्तथाभ्ययाद्द्रष्टुं कुमारवरमच्युतम् ।
नारदप्रमुखाश्चापि देवगन्धर्वसत्तमाः ॥

meaning.en: Shakra came too to see the best of boys, the unfallen one, and Narada and other foremost gods and gandharvas,

verses.text:
देवर्षयश्च सिद्धाश्च बृहस्पतिपुरोगमाः ।
ऋभवो नाम वरदा देवानामपि देवताः ।
तेऽपि तत्र समाजग्मुर्यामा धामाश्च सर्वशः ॥

meaning.en: divine sages and Siddhas led by Brihaspati, the Ribhus, who are boon-givers and gods even to the gods, and the Yamas and Dhamas too, came there from every side.

verses.text:
स तु बालोऽपि भगवान्महायोगबलान्वितः ।
अभ्याजगाम देवेशं शूलहस्तं पिनाकिनम् ॥

meaning.en: Though a child, the blessed one, endowed with great yoga power, came to the lord of gods, the trident-bearing Pinakin.

verses.text:
तमाव्रजन्तमालक्ष्य शिवस्यासीन्मनोगतम् ।
युगपच्छैलपुत्र्याश्च गङ्गायाः पावकस्य च ॥

meaning.en: Seeing him approach, the same thought rose at once in the minds of Shiva, the mountain's daughter, Ganga and Agni.

verses.text:
किं नु पूर्वमयं बालो गौरवादभ्युपैष्यति ।
अपि मामिति सर्वेषां तेषामासीन्मनोगतम् ॥

meaning.en: Will this child come to me first out of respect? That was the thought of each of them.

verses.text:
तेषामेतमभिप्रायं चतुर्णामुपलक्ष्य सः ।
युगपद्योगमास्थाय ससर्ज विविधास्तनूः ॥

meaning.en: Perceiving the intent of those four, he took up yoga and at once created several bodies.

verses.text:
ततोऽभवच्चतुर्मूर्तिः क्षणेन भगवान्प्रभुः ।
स्कन्दः शाखो विशाखश्च नैगमेषश्च पृष्ठतः ॥

meaning.en: Then in an instant the blessed lord became four-formed: Skanda, Shakha and Vishakha, and Naigamesha behind.

verses.text:
एवं स कृत्वा ह्यात्मानं चतुर्धा भगवान्प्रभुः ।
यतो रुद्रस्ततः स्कन्दो जगामाद्भुतदर्शनः ॥

meaning.en: Having thus made himself fourfold, the blessed lord went, of wondrous look, as Skanda toward Rudra.

verses.text:
विशाखस्तु ययौ येन देवी गिरिवरात्मजा ।
शाखो ययौ च भगवान्वायुमूर्तिर्विभावसुम् ।
नैगमेषोऽगमद्गङ्गां कुमारः पावकप्रभः ॥

meaning.en: Vishakha went to where the goddess, daughter of the great mountain, was; Shakha, the blessed one in the form of wind, went to Agni; and Naigamesha, the Kumara of fiery radiance, went to Ganga.

verses.text:
सर्वे भास्वरदेहास्ते चत्वारः समरूपिणः ।
तान्समभ्ययुरव्यग्रास्तदद्भुतमिवाभवत् ॥

meaning.en: All four had bright bodies and the same form, and they approached them undisturbed; it seemed a marvel.

verses.text:
हाहाकारो महानासीद्देवदानवरक्षसाम् ।
तद्दृष्ट्वा महदाश्चर्यमद्भुतं रोमहर्षणम् ॥

meaning.en: A great cry of alarm arose among gods, Danavas and rakshasas as they saw that great marvel, wonderful and hair-raising.

verses.text:
ततो रुद्रश्च देवी च पावकश्च पितामहम् ।
गङ्गया सहिताः सर्वे प्रणिपेतुर्जगत्पतिम् ॥

meaning.en: Then Rudra, the goddess, Agni and Ganga all bowed to the Grandfather, lord of the world.

verses.text:
प्रणिपत्य ततस्ते तु विधिवद्राजपुंगव ।
इदमूचुर्वचो राजन्कार्त्तिकेयप्रियेप्सया ॥

meaning.en: Having duly bowed, best of kings, they said this, wishing to please Karttikeya.

verses.text:
अस्य बालस्य भगवन्नाधिपत्यं यथेप्सितम् ।
अस्मत्प्रियार्थं देवेश सदृशं दातुमर्हसि ॥

meaning.en: Blessed lord, you should give this child the sovereignty he desires, one fitting him, lord of gods, for our pleasure.

verses.text:
ततः स भगवान्धीमान्सर्वलोकपितामहः ।
मनसा चिन्तयामास किमयं लभतामिति ॥

meaning.en: Then the wise and blessed Grandfather of all worlds considered in his mind: what should he receive?

verses.text:
ऐश्वर्याणि हि सर्वाणि देवगन्धर्वरक्षसाम् ।
भूतयक्षविहंगानां पन्नगानां च सर्वशः ॥

meaning.en: All sovereignties over gods, gandharvas and rakshasas, over spirits, yakshas, birds and serpents everywhere,

verses.text:
पूर्वमेवादिदेशासौ निकायेषु महात्मनाम् ।
समर्थं च तमैश्वर्ये महामतिरमन्यत ॥

meaning.en: he had earlier assigned to the great-souled ones among the groups; and the great-minded one judged this boy capable of sovereignty.

verses.text:
ततो मुहूर्तं स ध्यात्वा देवानां श्रेयसि स्थितः ।
सेनापत्यं ददौ तस्मै सर्वभूतेषु भारत ॥

meaning.en: Then, after a moment's thought, intent on the good of the gods, he gave him generalship over all beings, Bharata.

verses.text:
सर्वदेवनिकायानां ये राजानः परिश्रुताः ।
तान्सर्वान्व्यादिदेशास्मै सर्वभूतपितामहः ॥

meaning.en: The Grandfather of all beings commanded all the renowned kings of all the groups of gods to serve him.

verses.text:
ततः कुमारमादाय देवा ब्रह्मपुरोगमाः ।
अभिषेकार्थमाजग्मुः शैलेन्द्रं सहितास्ततः ॥

meaning.en: Then the gods led by Brahma took Kumara and went together to the lord of mountains for the consecration.

verses.text:
पुण्यां हैमवतीं देवीं सरिच्छ्रेष्ठां सरस्वतीम् ।
समन्तपञ्चके या वै त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुता ॥

meaning.en: They came to the holy Himalayan goddess, the best of rivers, the Sarasvati, famed in the three worlds at Samantapanchaka.

verses.text:
तत्र तीरे सरस्वत्याः पुण्ये सर्वगुणान्विते ।
निषेदुर्देवगन्धर्वाः सर्वे संपूर्णमानसाः ॥

meaning.en: There on the Sarasvati's holy bank, endowed with every virtue, the gods and gandharvas all sat, their hearts full.
